the comparison of commercially available organic polymer-based and porous silica-based monolithic stationary phases for the separation of selected mixtures of analyte molecules.

both silica-based and polymer-based monolith columns are suitable for the fast separation and characterization of complex mixtures of small molecules and proteins.

the choice of a monolithic stationary phase should depend on the size and chemistry of the analyte.
